hooks.name: golden-trace-replay
hooks.description: Replay the heat-day scenario and diff against the golden trace.

action.prompt: The user saved agent/planner.py or agent/critic.py. Run the heat-day scenario end to end with `make replay`, then diff the produced trace against tests/golden/trace.jsonl. Report any step where plan version, EJ share, tool name, or tool order changed. Do not modify any file.
